releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.1.0 — Zero-CPU FrameGen & Total Lag Elimination:
- Zero-CPU Architecture: Completely eliminated the background thread spin-wait loop in OmniMotionEngine. Idle CPU usage is now 0.0%, freeing 100% of CPU cores for Battlefield and games.
- Lag & Stutter Fix: Removed DwmFlush polling stalls that caused game micro-stutters and network packet queue latency.
- Real-World DLSS 3 Guide: Step-by-step in-game configuration for Battlefield (Options > Video > DLSS Quality & DLSS Frame Generation ON).
- Automatic PC Restart Prompts.
